offer.text: Good steel starts with good iron. Bring me 6 ingots and I'll forge the village a proper blade.

accept.text: Folded and tempered, it'll hold an edge for years. My thanks.

decline.text: Then the militia drills with sticks.

in_progress.text: Have you the iron for the forge?

ready.text: Six honest ingots. The hammer falls tonight.

complete.text: The next sword off this anvil is half yours.
